title: Eight Sleep system cards
description: A light-grey band that explains a product system in three parts: a centered heading that fades up, then a row of tall rounded photo cards where one is open and wide and the others narrow, each with a pill tag, a round + / × toggle and a white caption over a scrim; a black button below. On phones the cards stack with the caption under each photo.
notes: three media slots, 615×454 open / 333×454 closed on desktop, 350×263 on phones; muted placeholders when empty
